text:
Sophie: Quick sync: we need to finalize streaming behavior for /chat.completions w.r.t. message deltas + function/tool calling. Two things: (1) role presence on deltas, (2) deterministic way to stream function_call arguments so clients can reassemble reliably.

Raj: TL;DR: role should be present on the first delta (so clients know assistant/system/user), but servers MAY omit role on later deltas to save bytes. Clients must tolerate missing role after the first chunk. For function_call we will stream name when known, and arguments as incremental string chunks.

Maria: Implementation note: avoid sending big JSON blobs as a single delta. We'll stream arguments as string fragments that clients concat. Example SSE-like sequence we discussed (SSE framing preserved):
```
data: {"delta": {"role": "assistant"}}

data: {"delta": {"function_call": {"name": "lookup_price"}}}

data: {"delta": {"function_call": {"arguments": "{\"sku\": \"ABC123\", \"qty\": 1"}}}}

data: {"delta": {"function_call": {"arguments": " , "price": 9.99}"}}

data: {"delta": {"finish_reason": "function_call"}}
```
(Clients concatenate values of function_call.arguments in order.)

Sophie: So to be explicit: we will namespace argument chunks under `function_call.arguments` (string) rather than mixing into regular content deltas. That avoids ambiguity for clients that also stream plain message content.

Raj: Exactly. Rule: accumulate all `function_call.arguments` deltas in order until a delta has `finish_reason: "function_call"`. After that, consumers should parse the assembled string as JSON for the function call payload. If parsing fails, surface a reassembly/parsing error.

Kevin: I'll add a tiny example in the contract doc and a unit test that simulates splitting JSON across 5 random chunk boundaries to catch edge cases. PR (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtimes/pull/3121.

Maria: Back-compat: some older SDKs expect content-only streams. To help them, we will still send the function_call name as a discrete delta early on (so name is discoverable). But we won't backfill arguments into content deltas by default. Call out migration steps in the release notes.

Sophie: Also document that role MAY be omitted after first delta and that clients should not treat missing role as an error. Add a compatibility test that asserts behavior against older SDK mocks.

InfraBot: staging: streaming-schema-v2 rolled to staging (shard 2/3) :rocket:

Raj: One more SSE framing detail: keep `data: ` prefix lines and emit `data: [DONE]` after final event. For non-function finishes, include final full message (role + content) so non-streaming consumers get the same final shape. For function_call finishes, final event should still be `data: {"delta": {"finish_reason": "function_call"}}` then `data: [DONE]`.

Sophie: Good. Kevin, drop the PR link when ready and include the reassembly test. Also include an example client snippet that concatenates `function_call.arguments` deltas and calls JSON.parse.

Kevin: Will add. Minimal pseudo-test idea I'll include in PR: take valid JSON args string, split at 5 random offsets, feed as sequential `function_call.arguments` deltas, assert reassembled == original.

Maria: Note for docs: show clear parsing pseudocode and state that whitespace/newlines are preserved as-is; clients may need to trim only if they expect it.

Sophie: Thanks all. Action items: Kevin -> PR + tests. Raj -> add small clause in contract about optional role omissions. Maria -> update release notes compatibility section. Follow-up next week after running SDK checks. :+1:
